recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future detailed NDC usage correction belongs in HL7 Terminology/THO rather than in FHIR core for this already-applied URI request.
issue_request: FHIR-7524 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Vocabulary change request asking to define a system URI for the NDC OID 2.16.840.1.113883.6.69; Jira comments record implementers using http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/ndc because FDA did not provide a useful permalink.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 069fdd9067719c775cffbacc867421bad8739bbd applied the issue family with subject '#8046 / #7524 - define NDC usage', adding source/ndc.html and the NDC row in source/terminologies-systems.html.
additional_context: FHIR-8046 is the same-change duplicate/source-neighborhood issue. Later FHIR-35933 removed local external-code-system usage pages from FHIR core and retargeted the NDC link to HL7 Terminology, explaining why source/ndc.html is no longer present.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current core source identifies http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/ndc as the NDC/NHRIC coding system URI, records OID 2.16.840.1.113883.6.69, links to terminology.hl7.org/NDC.html, and is reachable from active terminology module navigation.
